answer: The strongest single control I know for this is bulletproof range proof of age, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 404 fakes pay 404 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. Hold the juniper up to the light, weigh the cedar of the attack, and keep the vault of the verdict where everyone can audit it. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
